Let's produce the method.assistantfinalpublic int minInsertions(String s) {
    int ans = 0;      // Number of insertions needed for unmatched ')'
    int open = 0;     // Current count of unmatched '('
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char c = s.charAt(i);
        if (c == '(') {
            open++;
        } else { // c == ')'
            if (open > 0) {
                open--;
            } else {
                ans++; // Insert a '(' before this ')'
            }
        }
    }
    // Each unmatched '(' still needs one ')' to balance
    ans += open;
    return ans;
}
